hook: A flat brass disc on a post holds a watchful glyph and a single cheerful bell. When trouble happens nearby, the glyph lights, the bell rings once, brightly, and then nothing else happens at all.

blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: A flat brass disc on a post holds a watchful glyph and a single cheerful bell. When trouble happens nearby, the glyph lights, the bell rings once, brightly, and then nothing else happens at all.

blocks.label: Maker Voice
blocks.body: THE INCIDENT RESPONSE PLACARD: Because Knowing Is Half the Battle. We Do Not Provide the Other Half. Detects 9 of 10 incidents. Responds to 0 of 10.

blocks.label: At The Table
blocks.body: Narrative cue. It detects nearby trouble, can be read for route data with Knowledge 12, and may ping Grail if tampered with.
